title: Consumer Care Note — Suspension of Payment Arrangements During Dispute and Hardship Holds
content:
An active plan under Payment Arrangements is suspended on the day its account enters dispute hold or hardship hold, and no debit is taken while it is suspended.

## When the hold ends

When the hold ends, the plan resumes only if the consumer agrees to restart; the first installment after resumption is the first unpaid installment, it falls due no sooner than the type's resume minimum in calendar days after the resumption date, later installments follow on the plan's frequency, and the final due date moves by the same amount. A consumer whose hold ends but who does not want to restart has the plan cancelled with the close reason "consumer cancelled".

## Cancellation of a suspended plan

- A suspended plan is cancelled with the close reason "suspension expired" only when the handling date is later than the suspension limit counted from the plan's suspended date. The suspension limit is the type's suspension limit figure in calendar days, the day after the suspended date being day one. The suspended date is read from the plan record.
- A suspended plan is cancelled with the close reason "account returned" when its account is returned to the client.

**Boundary (hypothetical dates).** A plan suspended on 1 March under a type whose limit is 30 days: day one is 2 March and day 30 is 31 March. On 31 March the handling date is not later than the limit and the plan is not cancelled as "suspension expired"; from 1 April it may be.

## Missed-installment counting

The clause stating that missed-installment counting stops while the plan is suspended is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis. The clause that missed-installment counting restarts from the new schedule remains in force.

## Outcomes at a glance

| Situation of a suspended plan | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Hold ends, consumer agrees to restart | Plan resumes on a new schedule |
| Hold ends, consumer does not want to restart | Cancelled — "consumer cancelled" |
| Handling date later than the suspension limit | Cancelled — "suspension expired" |
| Account returned to the client | Cancelled — "account returned" |

superseded_clauses: Missed-installment counting stops while the plan is suspended
